entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this useless VeloBand Cadence Sensor and I want to do it now. I am so done with your company.

I can certainly look into that return for you, and I'm sorry to hear you're feeling frustrated. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It doesn't matter what the issue is! The issue is your company! I tried to return this thing last week, well within your ridiculous time limit, and your website was completely broken. Now I'm at day 17 and I'm sure you're about to tell me it's too late. This is a scam!
I understand your concern about the timeline. You mentioned you tried to process the return last week when our site was down? Do you happen to remember the date you were trying?

Of course I do! It was January 5th. I have a **screenshot** of the **website error** message. Your whole **system** was **down** for hours and I **couldn't print** the stupid label. This is unacceptable. Get me your manager.

I can definitely check on that for you, and I assure you I'm empowered to resolve this. Let me just check our system logs for January 5th... Yes, I can see it right here. We had a confirmed server outage that afternoon that impacted our returns portal. I sincerely apologize for that. That failure was completely on our end.
So you admit it was your fault. What are you going to do about it?

Absolutely. Because this was a verified business fault, I am overriding the timeline and processing this as a valid return for a full refund. I am generating a pre-paid shipping label and emailing it to you as we speak. You should have it in your inbox within the next two minutes.
Wait, really? You're just... approving it? No fight?

That's correct. The error was ours, and you shouldn't be penalized for it. The email has been sent. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Huh. Okay. Well... thank you. I appreciate you actually listening and fixing it. I was ready for a battle.
You're very welcome, and again, I apologize for the initial trouble. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. I'll look for the email.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
